* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Sweet.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Drive-By|Drive-By]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Ryder.png]]Ryder's house, Grove Street, Ganton, Los Santos
* '''Time''': 12:00 - 20:00
|}

After the cutscene it will be 22:00, and you have until 06:00 (eight minutes real-time) to complete the mission. Get into the Boxville and drive Ryder to Colonel Fuhrberger's house. Once inside follow the instructions by staying quiet. The six boxes are:

# In the first room
# Through the door on the right
# On the first flight of stairs
# At the end of the hallway
# In the guy's room to the left
# In the guy's room behind his bed

You should have plenty of time to get them all, but three is enough. The first three listed above are the easiest and safest to collect (the closer you get to him the easier it is to wake him up). Drive back to the lock-up to complete the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Respect''': +5
